newsitem.title: UK: Enterprise completes Italy well appraisal.
newsitem.headline: Enterprise completes Italy well appraisal.

text.p: Enterprise Oil Plc said on Wednesday it had completed a succesful appraisal of the Cerro Falcone oil discovery in the south Apennine area of Italy along with its partner Agip, the oil exploration and production arm of Italian energy group ENI
The well, operated by Agip, tested 31 degrees API oil at a stabilised rate of 6,604 barrels per day through a 1 1/4 inch choke.
Enterprise said the the well would be put on long term production later this year prior to connection to the Val d'Agri production infrastructure.
This was the first time that the benefits of bilateral well technology have been demonstrated in Italy.
